parameters.query: SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.title, p.author, n.text_content, n.language FROM projects p LEFT JOIN novels n ON p.novel_id = n.id WHERE p.id = $1 AND p.state = 'validated'
INSERT INTO chapters (project_id, chapter_number, title, content, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NOW())

INSERT INTO scenes (project_id, chapter_id, scene_number, title, summary, characters_present, location, time_period, emotional_tone, word_count, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::jsonb, $7, $8, $9, $10, NOW())
UPDATE projects SET state = 'parsed', parsed_at = NOW(), total_chapters = $2, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1
INSERT INTO events (project_id, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES ($1, 'story_parsed', $2::jsonb, NOW())
